source_test: Invariant A holds under P1 (always-treated cohort, no never-treated)
assertion_family: ATT(g,t) common-cell missingness and finite values are invariant after dropping literal always-treated units across dr/reg/ipw and requested-fast modes

source_test: Invariant A holds under P2 (anticipation>=1 promotes earliest cohort)
assertion_family: ATT(g,t) common-cell missingness and finite values are invariant after dropping anticipation-promoted always-treated units

source_test: Invariant A holds under P3 (anticipation un-coerces a late cohort)
assertion_family: ATT(g,t) common-cell missingness and finite values are invariant after dropping anticipation-promoted always-treated units when a late cohort remains treated

source_test: always-treated outcomes are never read (scaling oracle)
assertion_family: ATT(g,t) values are invariant when outcomes for always-treated units are rescaled

source_test: fast and slow paths agree in the no-never + always-treated regime
assertion_family: Requested-fast and baseline paths agree in the no-never plus always-treated regime

source_test: latest cohort is retained as a control, not deleted, when always-treated present
assertion_family: Latest cohort remains in comparison data but is excluded from estimated ATT groups; always-treated cohort is dropped

source_test: control_group='nevertreated' is invariant to always-treated presence
assertion_family: Default nevertreated branch/fallback is invariant to literal always-treated units
